meta.industry: 户外装备折扣发现与价格追踪
meta.subtitle: 本地候选已建立 GEO 信息层；生产尚未发布，真实 AI 能见度未测量。

seo.verdict: 本地候选版本具备可用的抓取、语义、架构和内容基线，但国际化、独立权威与转化测量仍有实质缺口；该分数不代表当前生产站。

dimensions.name: Crawl and index foundations
dimensions.note: 候选版本有 robots、sitemap index、静态与商品 sitemap、canonical 和 noindex 合同；生产尚未发布。

dimensions.name: On-page semantics
dimensions.note: 核心页面具备标题、描述、单一 H1、语言、OG 与可解析 JSON-LD；规范 /p 商品页由服务端读取真实目录记录并输出 Product/Offer。

dimensions.name: Architecture and internal discovery
dimensions.note: 首页、页脚、品牌页、方法、FAQ、指南、状态页和商品 URL 互链；完整孤岛与分页分析未覆盖。

dimensions.name: Content and intent coverage
dimensions.note: 覆盖实体、数据口径、品牌、常见问题、选择与核验意图；英文内容和更细分比较意图仍不足。

dimensions.name: International and local targeting
dimensions.note: 主内容为 zh-CN，尚无成套 en-US 页面、hreflang 或市场入口。

dimensions.name: Authority and reputation
dimensions.note: 小样本未观察到目标服务的独立引用，且同名实体突出；未提供完整链接、评论或媒体数据。

dimensions.name: Conversion and measurement readiness
dimensions.note: 购买与 Support 动作清晰，但未执行生产提交、外链 canary、分析或后端回执对账。

geo.verdict: 候选版本已形成可检索、可识别、可直接回答并带方法边界的信息层；外部佐证不足，真实 AI 提及、引用和推荐仍为 not_measured。

dimensions.name: Retrieval and crawler accessibility
dimensions.note: 核心答案页及规范 /p 商品实体无需 JavaScript 即可读取，拥有稳定 URL、sitemap 与 llms 发现文件；生产尚未发布。

dimensions.name: Entity clarity and consistency
dimensions.note: 明确 GearDrop Outdoor Deals、规范域名、非销售/非品牌官网边界，并显式排除同名租赁与抽奖含义。

dimensions.name: Answer-ready coverage
dimensions.note: 关于、方法、FAQ、品牌与指南页面提供直接回答和购买前核验步骤。

dimensions.name: Evidence and citability
dimensions.note: 提供来源、币种、观察时间、计算公式、限制、商品原始链接和目录快照；缺独立作者与版本化外部研究。

dimensions.name: External corroboration
dimensions.note: 小样本未观察到目标服务的独立 corroboration，并观察到两个显著同名实体。

dimensions.name: Measurement readiness
dimensions.note: 已有冻结查询概念、readiness 审计、版本化快照与日程工作流；平台实验和结果仍未运行。

executive_summary.verdict: 本地候选版本已通过 81/81 readiness；当前生产仍为 9/33，尚不能宣称上线或 AI 能见度提升。
executive_summary.seo_verdict: 候选版本具备抓取、语义、架构和内容基线，国际化、独立权威与转化测量仍有缺口。
executive_summary.geo_verdict: 信息已可检索、识别和引用，但外部佐证不足，平台提及、引用与推荐均未测量。
executive_summary.opportunity: 先完成生产 81/81 与动作读回，再用 en-US、独立引用和 30/90 天冻结面板持续验证效果。
strengths: 服务器可读的实体、方法、FAQ、品牌、指南、目录状态和具体商品信息层。
8,219 个稳定商品实体 URL 及同批次、带时间边界的目录快照。
每日只读 readiness 与现有数据刷新后的 sitemap/status 更新机制。
risks: 候选版本尚未发布，生产仅通过 9/33。
同名租赁与抽奖实体突出，目标服务缺独立佐证。
en-US、转化回执与真实 AI 能见度尚未完成。
executive_summary.conclusion: 本地 GEO 候选版本已实现并通过 81/81 readiness 合同，但生产站仍是改动前基线：9/33 通过、24/33 失败，因此尚不能把改进描述为已上线。
what_changed: 新增可抓取的实体、数据方法、FAQ、选购指南、品牌和目录状态页面。
新增 8,219 个规范 /p 商品实体 URL、商品/静态 sitemap、robots、llms.txt、llms-full.txt 与同批次目录快照。
首页、交互详情和服务端商品页补齐可验证的语义、canonical、H1、内部链接和 JSON-LD；商品价格只从真实目录记录写入 Offer。
新增每日只读 readiness 工作流，并接入现有目录刷新工作流更新 sitemap 与状态快照。
highest_priority: 取得发布授权后部署候选版本，并用同一 81 项合同做生产读回。
建立独立 corroboration 与同名实体区分，避免 GearDrop 被解释为租赁或抽奖产品。
补齐 en-US 与 hreflang，并把 Support 本地化和转化回执纳入验收。
发布后冻结查询面板，在至少两个日期测量 AI 提及、引用、推荐与事实准确率。
executive_summary.truth_boundary: readiness、schema、sitemap、llms.txt 或普通搜索结果都不是 AI 推荐已发生的证明。

findings.title: 候选 GEO 信息层尚未发布到生产
findings.summary: 生产读回仅通过 9/33 项，实体、方法、FAQ、指南、品牌、目录状态、llms 和拆分 sitemap 均未上线，也没有规范的服务端商品实体页。
findings.business_impact: 搜索与生成式系统仍只能看到旧的薄信息层，无法利用本轮实现；把本地结果当上线会造成错误决策。
findings.recommendation: 在独立审批后发布，随后运行生产 readiness 检查并人工复核首页、商品、方法、状态和 Support；任何关键失败都应回滚或修复后再声明上线。

evidence.label: Production readiness report
evidence.observation: 2026-08-14 production readback passed 9 of 33 checks and failed 24.

evidence.label: Local candidate readiness report
evidence.observation: The local candidate passed 81 of 81 checks.

findings.title: 同名实体突出且目标服务缺少独立佐证
findings.summary: 日期限定的小样本搜索未返回目标域名，却返回 GearDrop 租赁服务和 BaseMap GearDrop 抽奖游戏。
findings.business_impact: 生成式系统和用户可能把目标服务与其他 GearDrop 混淆；仅靠 owned-site 自述难以形成稳定信任。
findings.recommendation: 稳定使用 GearDrop Outdoor Deals 辅助名称与规范域名，并争取与方法、目录数据和真实使用价值相关的独立引用；不得把合作方或自有内容计作独立背书。

evidence.label: Same-name rental entity
evidence.observation: An unrelated GearDrop entity presents itself as a backcountry equipment rental service.

evidence.label: Same-name giveaway entity
evidence.observation: BaseMap uses GearDrop for an outdoor giveaway game.

findings.title: en-US 与多市场发现面尚不完整
findings.summary: 候选知识层主要是 zh-CN，尚无完整 en-US 对应页、hreflang 或可核验的市场入口。
findings.business_impact: 美国英语用户与英语生成式查询可能缺少语言匹配、实体一致性和地区口径。
findings.recommendation: 先为实体、方法、FAQ、指南和品牌页建立内容等价的 en-US 版本，再加 self/alternate/x-default hreflang；不要只做机器直译或共享错误价格口径。

evidence.label: Local entity page
evidence.observation: The candidate page declares zh-CN and no paired en-US knowledge route was observed.

findings.title: 转化与第一方搜索结果缺少可复核基线
findings.summary: 没有 Search Console、analytics、CRM 或生产 canary 回执，Support 提交和外部购买动作也未执行。
findings.business_impact: 即使发现面改善，也无法区分抓取、点击、合格动作和真实业务结果。
findings.recommendation: 定义品牌/非品牌搜索、有效出站点击、Support 成功与错误事件，发布后先做受控 canary，再建立 30 天同口径基线。

evidence.label: Website experience audit
evidence.observation: The form and purchase path were inspected but not submitted; analytics and backend reconciliation were unavailable.

findings.title: 真实 AI 能见度尚未测量
findings.summary: 本轮是 readiness_only，未在冻结市场、语言、账号、记忆、模型与日期条件下执行平台查询。
findings.business_impact: 无法回答 GearDrop 是否已被提及、引用、推荐，或回答中的价格与行动是否准确。
findings.recommendation: 生产稳定后运行冻结查询面板，区分无提示品牌与提示品牌、提及与引用、推荐与事实准确，并在至少两个日期复测。

evidence.label: Audit plan
evidence.observation: measurement_mode is readiness_only with zero platform repetitions.

roadmap.title: 发布与生产读回
roadmap.deliverable: Deploy candidate, run 81-item production readiness readback, verify representative pages and rollback notes.
actions: 取得发布审批并保留回滚点
独立复核桌面、移动、服务端商品与 Support
roadmap.success: 81/81 production readiness plus independent browser readback; otherwise no上线 claim.

roadmap.title: 建立同定义基线
roadmap.deliverable: Search Console/analytics definitions, conversion canaries, and first complete GEO panel.
actions: 完成批准的动作 canary 与回执对账
运行第一次完整 GEO 面板
roadmap.success: Complete denominators, retained answers, reconciled events, and explicit not_measured fields where sources remain unavailable.

roadmap.title: 补齐语言与独立佐证
roadmap.deliverable: en-US entity/method/guide equivalents and relevant independent citations.
actions: 发布 en-US 等价内容与 hreflang
统一 GearDrop Outdoor Deals 实体描述
逐条分类独立引用与关系
roadmap.success: hreflang pairs pass, same-name ambiguity declines in sampled results, and citations are independently classified.

roadmap.title: 按证据持续优化
roadmap.deliverable: Daily readiness, monthly coverage review, 30/90-day GEO retests, and evidence-backed backlog reprioritization.
actions: 每日检查 readiness 漂移
每月复核搜索、覆盖和动作
按 30/90 天重复效果调整 backlog
roadmap.success: No readiness regression; improvements repeat across dates and more than one query group before promotion.

kpis.name: Production GEO readiness contract
kpis.definition: 同一公开发现、实体、schema 与真值边界合同。

kpis.name: Stable product entity URLs
kpis.definition: 同一批活跃目录生成的规范商品 URL；不等于收录或库存。
kpis.boundary: Directory coverage only; not indexation or stock.

kpis.definition: Search Console 中有效收录且 canonical 正确的页面。

kpis.name: Unaided AI mention rate
kpis.definition: 有效无品牌提示运行中提及 GearDrop 的比例。

kpis.definition: 提及 GearDrop 的有效运行中包含可核验引用的比例。

kpis.name: Recommendation rate and factual accuracy
kpis.definition: 推荐意图运行中的推荐比例及被评估回答的事实准确率。

kpis.name: Qualified outbound and Support completion
kpis.definition: 排除测试和重复事件后的有效销售平台出站与 Support 成功。
kpis.source: Analytics and backend reconciliation not provided

limitations: The readiness scores describe the local candidate, not the current production deployment.
The production site has not been modified, deployed, pushed, or submitted in this task.
AI platform visibility was not measured and must not be inferred from technical readiness.
Search Console, analytics, CRM, backlink exports, full review data, and server logs were not provided.
The external-authority assessment is a small date-bound search sample, not an exhaustive awareness or indexing study.
Retailer stock, checkout eligibility, tax, shipping, and returns were not independently revalidated for all 8,219 rows.
Support submission and external purchase actions were not performed.

sources.supports: Production HTTP and pre-release readiness baseline.

sources.supports: Local readiness contract and representative browser observations.

methodology.notes: 基于仓库结构、生产 HTTP 读回、本地 81 项合同、代表性桌面/移动浏览器走查和日期限定搜索样本；未执行 AI 平台实验。
methodology.score_boundary: SEO and GEO scores apply to the local candidate only; production is reported as a separate raw readiness baseline.
methodology.visibility_boundary: Observed visibility is not measured and is excluded from GEO readiness.

risk_gates.name: Production crawler and index access
risk_gates.note: The candidate discovery and entity surfaces are not deployed.

risk_gates.name: Entity consistency
risk_gates.note: The candidate disambiguates the entity, but production and independent corroboration do not yet carry that distinction.

risk_gates.name: Material factual accuracy
risk_gates.note: The live catalog snapshot is first-party directory data; retailer stock and checkout were not exhaustively revalidated.

risk_gates.name: Market and language correctness
risk_gates.note: The declared en-US target lacks a complete localized knowledge surface and hreflang.

risk_gates.name: Action validity
risk_gates.note: No Support submission or retailer checkout action was performed.

risk_gates.name: Privacy and credential handling
risk_gates.note: The reviewed Support page links to Privacy and the audit transmitted no personal data or credentials.

risk_gates.name: Severe safety or reputation claim
risk_gates.note: Candidate pages explicitly reject brand authorization, sales, stock guarantees, and AI recommendation claims.

evidence_claims.claim: The production baseline passed 9 of 33 readiness checks.
The local candidate passed 81 of 81 readiness checks.
The generated catalog snapshot contains 8,219 active product URLs from one observed batch.
Unrelated rental and giveaway services use the GearDrop name.
AI mention, citation, recommendation, and accuracy are not measured.
